verdict.rationale: Airweave's agentic search mode uses an AI agent that iteratively searches your synced data, reads full documents and navigates entity hierarchies to build a result set. That is AI-driven retrieval over your data, but the output is search results rather than generated insights or suggestions. The product is positioned as a developer building block for downstream agents rather than an in-product insights experience. Missing for 10: AI-generated summaries, insights or proactive suggestions; any documented in-product (dashboard) AI insight experience; independent corroboration.
